threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'Tube' instead of the 'Underground'—loud and clear you’re new to the East.
Caught a whiff of jerk chicken from a late-night stall while waiting for the bus. It's always the same guy, flipping patties like it's a secret art.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when the scent of Turkish bread wafted through the streets, mixing with the hum of late-night kebab shops and laughter.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain do you find a club that doubles as a church on weekends, complete with a techno mass. It's surreal and oddly spiritual.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they know not to panic during a BART delay – just grab a burrito and settle in for the wait.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus that stopped for a street performer mid-ride. The whole bus clapped when the song ended. Pure SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the parks and plazas, but it’s the hidden boutiques and local bakeries that truly pulse with life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by the way they order 'café con leche' at any hour—only tourists sip it after 11 AM.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You ask for a ‘cuppa’ at a café and get a confused look. It's tea, mate, not a trendy new drink.
Last night, on the 59, a guy serenaded us with old school raps while trying to sell a broken phone. Best night bus entertainment I've had in ages.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a street musician serenading a cat in a sunbeam outside my window—only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a spontaneous parade of cyclists celebrating a random Tuesday. It's like a local holiday no one else knows about!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they navigate BART delays—total calm, casually checking their phone while others panic. It's an art.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 31 Balboa yesterday. A guy was busting out opera while we waited 20 mins. Bravo to him, but I just wanted to get home!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the lively plazas are for festivals. In reality, locals use them for quiet chats and siestas, not just celebrations.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still asking for a ‘taxi’ instead of ‘cab’ and looking up how to pronounce ‘Sagrada Família’ as they walk past it.
